primary_reads.title: Swinburne and Perez, Self-optimized construction of transition rate matrices from accelerated atomistic simulations with Bayesian uncertainty quantification
primary_reads.access: Full HTML retrieved; introduction, rate-estimation sections and SectionIV equations30-37 inspected.
primary_reads.finding: Prior uncertainty-directed state discovery and allocation using global absorbing residence-time response; different Bayesian/TAD/metastable-basin access from deterministic conductance-box queries.
primary_reads.limits: No TAMMBER benchmark replicated; no claim its Bayesian estimator provides deterministic global box coverage.

primary_reads.title: Ryu et al., Reducing Weighted Ensemble Variance With Optimal Trajectory Management
primary_reads.access: Full HTML retrieved; abstract, introduction and methods2.2-2.3 including equations1-3 inspected.
primary_reads.finding: WE already uses local MFPT and its conditional variance for allocation and optimizes high-dimensional molecular tests.
primary_reads.limits: No WE implementation or equal-input end-to-end benchmark run.

primary_reads.title: Lichtinger and Covino, Accelerated descriptor-free path sampling for protein-ligand binding kinetics
primary_reads.access: Primary abstract and version metadata inspected.
primary_reads.finding: Reports committor-based path sampling, descriptor-free equivariant model and basin-restricted static bias across ligand systems.
primary_reads.limits: Abstract only; source result not replicated or independently assessed.

primary_reads.title: Aristoff and Lelievre, Mathematical Analysis of Temperature Accelerated Dynamics
primary_reads.access: Full HTML retrieved; idealized-TAD and quasistationary-distribution assumptions around Section3.1 inspected.
primary_reads.finding: Accelerated temperature methods have an exact/limiting theoretical framework under specified assumptions.
primary_reads.limits: Does not itself acquire this packet global microscopic conductance envelopes.

primary_reads.title: Elmatad and Jack, Space-time phase transitions in the East model with a softened kinetic constraint
primary_reads.access: Full HTML retrieved; model/constraint discussion and master operator equation12 inspected.
primary_reads.finding: Softened East is established model lineage; packet uses explicitly defined open-boundary rescaling and target absorption.
primary_reads.limits: No calibrated atomistic molecule; inherited phase-transition claims are not used as proof premises.
